thread:
sam-finops: morning  quick one  noticed monthly GPU spend looks ~12% higher than forecasting model. digging into the ETL and seeing duplicate charge rows for preempted instances. anyone aware of recent preempt/recreate behavior?
leo-ops: we had a change last week to accelerate node recovery: when a preempted VM restarts we now create a new instance with the same resource name for safety. that might produce two charge events in the raw export if the preempted line isn't marked final.
tia-platform: yikes. can you paste example lines?
sam-finops: example from billing export (redacted):
```
resource,project,zone,event_time,cost,charge_state
gpu-ax12,redwood-prod,us-east1-b,2026-05-04T03:12:01Z,420.00,provisional
gpu-ax12,redwood-prod,us-east1-b,2026-05-04T03:27:44Z,420.00,final
```
Looks like provisional + final both imported. ETL is summing both.
billing-bot: Alert FIN-930 created for duplicate provisional/final billing rows. https://billing.internal/tickets/FIN-930
leo-ops: confirm. our reclaim/recreate flow emits an interim provisional charge when the instance is allocated, then finalizes after the VM completes. ETL should dedupe on (resource,event_id) or prefer final over provisional. i'll patch.
sam-finops: what's the expected exposure for May so we can adjust budgets? preliminary scan shows ~ $15k of duplicated GPU charge lines across prod and research projects.
sara-cfo: that's material. we need ledger corrections if duplicates were posted. finance, recommend temporary hold on month-close until we dedupe and rerun allocation. if not possible, apply provisional reversal entries and note in CFO report.
tia-platform: i'll open a hotfix to the billing ETL: 1) prefer final entries when available; 2) ignore provisional rows older than 48h if final exists; 3) emit audit flag when provisional/final mismatch > $500/resource. PR#5012.
leo-ops: also adding a small retry window to node recreate to avoid duplicate resource names; we'll include a UUID suffix for ephemeral names to make dedupe easier.
sam-finops: please also dump the list of affected invoice IDs to /reports/finance/FIN-930-duplicates.csv so we can issue adjustment entries. finance will prepare reversing journal lines for posted invoices and provisional credits for customers with live disputes.
billing-bot: FIN-930 updated: affected invoices exported to /reports/finance/FIN-930-duplicates.csv. Follow-up assigned to sam-finops and leo-ops.
sara-cfo: decision: hold month-close 24h while the ETL hotfix runs. If hotfix not completed in 24h, finance to create provisional reversal entries and close with note. Approve?
sam-finops: approved. i'll draft the provisional reversal wording: "We detected duplicated provisional charge rows for preempted/recreated GPU instances. We are deduplicating billing records and applying reversal entries where needed; see FIN-930 for details."
tia-platform: hotfix deployed to staging; running backfill dedupe job now (job-id dedupe-1792). ETA 2h.
leo-ops: rolling the name-change to prod after staging pass. also updating runbook to prevent future duplicate-imports.
billing-bot: dedupe-1792 completed on staging. Matched 98% of provisional/final pairs. Running prod backfill now.
sam-finops: prod backfill done. recovered $14,760 of duplicated charges; remaining $240 ambiguous and will be provisionally reversed. updated ledger entries created (journal rev-1792).
sara-cfo: good work. sam: include note in CFO report and tag FIN-930 for closure once legal/ops confirm no customer disputes. Also recommend we add a monthly automated check for provisional/final duplication > $1k.
sam-finops: will add the check and close FIN-930 after 7-day observation. thanks team. :thumbsup:
